text:
Hi all,
Weather for our camping trip looks dodgy. Current forecasts have rain pretty much all weekend. We are making sure the event can go ahead as planned but adjusting things so it's safe and sensible. As planned, we'll have covered space for meals and briefings and group activities, but any outdoor stuff might get shortened or moved around depending on the weather.
Please pack accordingly. Waterproof stuff, proper boots, dry bags for your stuff, change of clothes. Make sure you have rain fly on your tent, and I'd recommend a ground tarp as well. We'll have a bit of storage inside but not a lot, so make sure you keep any valuables or electronics safe.
If you're coming with company transport, times remain the same.
Safety first, so we will be watching the forecast the whole weekend and update you if things change. We'll let you know on email or in the group chat. If it gets really bad, we'll have a backup indoor venue, and we'll get back to you with details. If you're not keen on camping in the rain, please contact People Ops, and we'll see what we can do. We have a day-trip option as well.
Happy to answer any questions, just drop a message to the events team.
Looking forward to it, and thanks for being flexible.
Cheers
